definitions.explanation: The process of getting better from an illness or injury. Almost always used in the fixed expression {快方|かいほう}に{向|む}かう (to head toward recovery).

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{快方|かいほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かっている→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
{手術後|しゅじゅつご}、⟦{順調|じゅんちょう}→順調：03282_junchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{快方|かいほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かっている→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: After the surgery, recovery is progressing smoothly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入院|にゅういん}していた→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{快方|かいほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かっている→向かう：01186_mukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{安心|あんしん}した→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧。
examples.english: I was relieved to hear that my grandfather, who was hospitalized, is recovering.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost exclusively used in the expression {快方|かいほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧ (to head toward recovery). Rarely appears in other constructions. A somewhat formal word, often used in medical or news contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {快方|かいほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧ (to be recovering)
- {快方|かいほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かっている→向かう：01186_mukau⟧ (is recovering)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧: recovery — more widely used and versatile, applies to health, economy, data, etc.
- ⟦{全快|ぜんかい}→全快：16255_zenkai⟧: complete recovery — emphasizes being fully healed
